parsed.title: Unlock Image Generation Credit
parsed.oneLiner: Play two quick mini-games with Luzia to earn an AI image generation credit.

newMechanic.name: Rewarded Image Credits
newMechanic.description: Users can play two mini-games with Luzia to earn an image generation credit when they hit their AI usage quota.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Allows free users to continue generating images by bundling views, improving unit economics to be sustainable for high-cost image generation.

parsed.trigger: When user attempts to generate an image in the Image Creation Hub and their AI Usage Quota (r3) is depleted.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users who have exhausted their free AI Usage Quota (r3).

offer.title: Earn an image credit
offer.body: Play 2 quick games with Luzia to get 1 free AI image generation credit.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Limited to 2 credits per day and requires a 2:1 view-to-credit bundle; ensures non-payers maintain usage without unlimited free generation and aligns with sustainable unit economics.

kpis.holdout: 10% of non-paying user base held out for 4 weeks.

risks: Ad fatigue due to two-view bundle requirement
Brand safety concerns in AI-generated images
Potential for lower paid conversion if reward is too generous

evidence.quote: Mix or swap elements from photos

newScreens.change: Rewarded ad invitation modal for image credit bundle.

newElements.change: Button to trigger rewarded ad bundle for 1 image credit when limit is reached.
